Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.lightning

Class LightningLoopClient

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.lightning.LightningLoopClient
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="lightning.loop", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class LightningLoopClient extends Object
Optional Lightning Loop (loopd) REST client for submarine swaps when circular self-pay is insufficient.

Enable with lightning.loop.enabled=true and lightning.loop.base-url.

  • Constructor Details

    • LightningLoopClient

      public LightningLoopClient(@Qualifier("lndRestTemplate") org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate restTemplate, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, @Value("${lightning.loop.base-url}") String baseUrl, @Value("${lightning.loop.macaroon:}") String macaroonHex, @Value("${lightning.loop.max-swap-fee-sats:10000}") long maxSwapFeeSats, @Value("${lightning.loop.max-miner-fee-sats:5000}") long maxMinerFeeSats)
      Creates the optional loopd client and normalizes endpoint and fee policy settings.
      Parameters:
      restTemplate - HTTP client shared with the LND REST integration
      objectMapper - JSON serializer and parser
      baseUrl - loopd REST base URL
      macaroonHex - optional loopd macaroon in hexadecimal form
      maxSwapFeeSats - swap-service fee ceiling in satoshis
      maxMinerFeeSats - on-chain miner-fee ceiling in satoshis

    • loopOut

      public LightningLoopClient.LoopResult loopOut(long amountSats, List<String> outgoingChanIds)
      Starts a Loop Out swap that converts Lightning funds to an on-chain destination. Optional channel identifiers are sent as numeric values when parseable, otherwise as text.
      Parameters:
      amountSats - requested swap amount in satoshis
      outgoingChanIds - optional channel IDs to constrain the outgoing route
      Returns:
      operation result containing loopd swap identifier or failure detail
